card.name: The word used in discard instructions
card.fires_on: The word "used" right after discard, throw away or dispose of (the), before a device such as a syringe, vial, pen, needle or pipette.

modes.label: Discard the used device
modes.description: "used" follows a discard verb and precedes a syringe, pen, vial or similar item.
modes.example: 6 Discard the<< used>> syringe into a sharps container.

modes.label: Discard used vial or product
modes.description: "used" comes directly after Discard, with no "the", before a vial or product.
modes.example: For single use only. Discard<< used>> vial, including any unused contents.

card.plain: It marks the word "used" in instructions to throw away a used syringe, vial or other device.
